stage: M75 planned: return to diverse whole-task validation coverage
reason: M74 closes the local-versus-finite metric detour. Representation decisions require broader task validation before more fitting or manifold claims.
first_action: Audit authoritative training inventories and historical task definitions for these seven whole-task training exclusions. Record prior evaluation exposure separately. Distinguish tense operation from past_tense training examples; do not infer exclusion from name alone.
cohort: Prepare exactly eight reciprocal contrast pairs per exclusion family using two fixed templates with four content instances each, or reuse an existing equivalent frozen cohort with documented provenance. Freeze full tokenized prompts, answer sets, template/content groups, alignment eligibility and hashes before native scoring. Do not tune prompts after observing scores. If an existing family definition conflicts, resolve the definition from records before freezing.
native_test: Measure full outputs, answer-group margins, binary and top1 correctness for both endpoints; evaluate native source and final write-change responses at MLP1, retain all failures/zero responses/unequal-length source ineligibilities. Native competence flag: at least six of eight pairs correct on both endpoints by answer-group margin. Always report full cohort; use the flag only to qualify claims about demonstrated task computation.
deliverable: A frozen diverse evaluation cohort, audited native competence/effect records, and fixed joint-comparison protocol for existing18original sparse encoders,18fullLS dense encoders and PCA32/PCA128. No refits, winning seed selection or new loss sweep. Preserve all model and task results in the later comparison.
interpretation: Whole-task training exclusion is not necessarily pristine evaluation; audit and disclose historical exposure. These are authored labels, not discoveries from unlabeled structure. Successful transfer is a prerequisite for subsequent manifold/reusable-component validation, not proof of it.
stop: One cohort and native competence audit, no prompt rescue after outcomes. Then the frozen joint comparison on the same cohort; if competence is weak, report that limitation and keep weak tasks out of semantic-computation claims without deleting results.
